parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u."name"),''), u."email") AS "fullName", 'cumple' AS "type", 0 AS "years", (SELECT up.phone FROM "UserPhone" up WHERE up."userId" = u.id LIMIT 1) AS "phone" FROM "User" u WHERE u."storeId" = 'clarvex-demo-store' AND u."active" = true AND u."isDemo" = false AND u."checklistOnly" = false AND u."birthDate" IS NOT NULL AND to_char(u."birthDate",'MM-DD') = to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey'),'MM-DD') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u."name"),''), u."email"), 'aniversario', date_part('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey')::int - date_part('year', u."hireDate")::int, (SELECT up.phone FROM "UserPhone" up WHERE up."userId" = u.id LIMIT 1) AS "phone" FROM "User" u WHERE u."storeId" = 'clarvex-demo-store' AND u."active" = true AND u."isDemo" = false AND u."checklistOnly" = false AND u."hireDate" IS NOT NULL AND to_char(u."hireDate",'MM-DD') = to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey'),'MM-DD') AND date_part('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey')::int - date_part('year', u."hireDate")::int >= 1 ORDER BY "type";
